item.description:
Saved articles keep their images and lose the clutter, and X articles save properly.

  • Fixed: some articles showed an empty image box where a picture should be. Scribe now saves the full-size image from responsive and lazy-loading pages, and no longer falls back to the web for it.
  • Fixed: images on old pages linked over plain http, and pictures saved from the Wayback Machine, now save properly.
  • Fixed: images that sit in their own blocks between paragraphs, as on BBC News, are no longer dropped, and a piece's lead photo is kept.
  • Fixed: X articles save from the article's own link as well as the post sharing it, with the right title, author, cover and images.
  • "Listen to this article" players, subscribe and share prompts, comment counts, promos and footers no longer end up in the reader.
  • Older pages in other text encodings now save instead of failing, and bylines lose their stray "by" and commas.
  • A site that turns Scribe away now says so, instead of suggesting you check the link.
  • Articles you've already saved have their images repaired once, the first time you open this version.

A tidy-up of Scribe's wording.

  • Em dashes in the app's text are now plain hyphens, including the bullets in What's New.
  • Smoothed the grammar of several messages, from the backlog's intro to Settings and the Save sheet.
  • Error messages for pieces that can't be opened now read like the rest of Scribe.

Updates now download by themselves and wait for a restart.

  • Scribe checks for a new version every time it opens, as well as once a day.
  • New versions download quietly in the background; a "Restart to update" button appears in the top bar when one is ready.
  • If you'd rather not restart yet, the update installs the next time you quit Scribe.
